title: Elden Ring Somber Smithing Stone 9 Locations: Where to Find and Buy Them
description: Find Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations in Elden Ring, where to buy them infinitely, how to get one early, and which Bell Bearing unlocks the shop.
body:
Somber Smithing Stone [9] upgrades a special weapon from +8 to +9, and each weapon only needs one.

If you want one early, Dragonbarrow has two useful pickups that can be reached long before Crumbling Farum Azula. Later in the game, Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] lets you buy an unlimited supply from the Twin Maiden Husks for 25,000 runes each.

The Bell Bearing is found near the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Elden Ring map showing the Somber Smithing Stone 9 location south of the Divine Tower of Caelid in Dragonbarrow.
imageCredit: Screenshot: Den of Geek / Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.

contentBlocks.text:
After you give **Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5]** to the **Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold**, they will sell Somber Smithing Stone [9] for **25,000 runes each**.

The supply is unlimited, which makes this the easiest option if you want to take several special weapons to +9.

Because Somber weapons only use one stone per upgrade tier, you need just **one Somber Smithing Stone [9] per weapon**.
contentBlocks.heading: Where to buy Somber Smithing Stone 9

contentBlocks.text:
**Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is in Crumbling Farum Azula, close to the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace.** It is a pickup, not a boss reward.

From the Site of Grace:

1. Turn around and take the nearby elevator down.
2. Walk down the stairs.
3. Enter the chapel ahead.
4. Loot the corpse beside the altar.
5. Return to Roundtable Hold and give the Bell Bearing to the Twin Maiden Husks.

For a dedicated route, see Neural Critic's [Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 location guide](/stories/elden-ring-somberstone-miners-bell-bearing-5-location/).
contentBlocks.heading: How to get Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5

contentBlocks.text:
You can get a Somber Smithing Stone [9] before reaching Crumbling Farum Azula.

**Near the Divine Tower of Caelid:** A stone can be looted from a corpse near the base of the tower, east of the Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace. Look for the corpse surrounded by chairs.

**West of Farum Greatbridge:** A Teardrop Scarab in Dragonbarrow drops another Somber Smithing Stone [9].

Dragonbarrow is dangerous at low levels, but both pickups are available much earlier than the Bell Bearing. If you already know which special weapon you want to use, either one can get it to +9 surprisingly early.
contentBlocks.heading: How to get Somber Smithing Stone 9 early

contentBlocks.text:
There are several more Somber Smithing Stone [9] pickups later in the game:

- **Lake of Rot:** On a corpse on the raised platform where a lesser Alabaster Lord appears.
- **Mountaintops of the Giants:** On a corpse sitting on a chair on the bridge south of Stargazer Ruins.
- **Consecrated Snowfield:** Several can be found across the region, including north of the Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace and east of the Apostate Derelict.
- **Yelough Anix Tunnel:** One is inside the tunnel in the room where an Onyx Lord appears.
- **Crumbling Farum Azula:** Several are scattered around the Dragon Temple and surrounding ruins.
- **Miquella's Haligtree and Elphael:** Additional stones can be found along the Haligtree route.

If you only need one stone, the early Dragonbarrow pickups are usually simpler. If you need several, the Bell Bearing is the better long-term solution.
contentBlocks.caption: Crumbling Farum Azula contains several Somber Smithing Stone [9] pickups beyond the earlier Dragonbarrow sources. Screenshot: GameWith; Elden Ring © Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.
contentBlocks.heading: Other Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations
contentBlocks.imageAlt: A Somber Smithing Stone 9 pickup is highlighted on the ruined stone rooftops of Crumbling Farum Azula in Elden Ring.

contentBlocks.text:
Shadow of the Erdtree adds more Somber Smithing Stone [9] pickups in the Realm of Shadow, including sources around **Castle Ensis, Shadow Keep, the Ancient Ruins of Rauh and Enir-Ilim**.

You do not need the DLC to get Somber Smithing Stone [9], though. The base game already has several pickups and the Bell Bearing that unlocks unlimited purchases.
contentBlocks.heading: Somber Smithing Stone 9 in Shadow of the Erdtree

contentBlocks.text:
Somber Smithing Stone [9] upgrades a **special armament from +8 to +9**.

The final step from +9 to +10 uses a **Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone**, which is a different and much more limited material.

If your weapon uses the standard +25 upgrade path instead, see Neural Critic's [Smithing Stone 8 locations guide](/stories/elden-ring-smithing-stone-8-locations/). For broader upgrade advice, our [Elden Ring early-game progression guide](/stories/elden-ring-early-progression-what-to-upgrade-first/) covers what is worth strengthening first.
contentBlocks.caption: Somber Smithing Stone [9] is the material used for the +8 to +9 step on special armaments. Neural Critic gameplay screenshot.
contentBlocks.heading: What does Somber Smithing Stone 9 upgrade?
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The Elden Ring blacksmith menu shows a special weapon upgrade and its required upgrade materials.

quickRead: Somber Smithing Stone [9] upgrades a special armament from +8 to +9, and each weapon only needs one.
Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is found near the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace in Crumbling Farum Azula and unlocks unlimited Somber Smithing Stone [9] purchases.
You can get Somber Smithing Stone [9] earlier in Dragonbarrow from a corpse near the Divine Tower of Caelid or a Teardrop Scarab west of Farum Greatbridge.
conclusion:
If you only need one Somber Smithing Stone [9], the Dragonbarrow pickups are the fastest option and can be reached much earlier than the Bell Bearing.

If you want to upgrade several special weapons, collect Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] in Crumbling Farum Azula. After turning it in at Roundtable Hold, you can buy as many Somber Smithing Stone [9] items as you need for 25,000 runes each.
